title: Permutation In String
prompt: Given two strings s1 and s2, return true if s2 contains a permutation of s1, or false otherwise. In other words, return true if one of s1's permutations is the substring of s2.
constraints: s1 and s2 consist of lowercase English letters.
hints: A permutation of s1 has the same character counts as s1. Use a sliding window of length s1.length.
Count characters in s1. Slide a window of size len(s1) over s2, and check if the window has matching counts.
When sliding, decrement count for character leaving the window, increment for character entering. Compare with s1's counts.
O(n) time. Use two count arrays or a single array with diff tracking.
